name: IEF Elephant Conservation and Research Funding Support
summary: Annual small grants (average award $15,000 per year) from the International Elephant Foundation for field projects on human-elephant conflict, habitat conservation, anti-poaching and related elephant work. Applications for 2027 funding have closed.

eligibility.rule: Requests no out-of-country travel, guns, paid informants, degree tuition, overhead or contingency costs
Starting the project on or after February 1, 2027
Indian applicants or their organizations have international funding authorization and FCRA documentation

documents: Recent photo of elephant(s) in the project area
Organization or entity country recognition, if appropriate
Permits, letters of support and government endorsement
FCRA documentation, if the applicant is from India

status.quote: is now closed for Application Submissions.

window.quote: To be considered for funding in 2027, applicants are required to complete the APPLICATION IN ENGLISH, using the ONLINE APPLICATION and SUBMIT by the due date below

access.quote: To be considered for funding in 2027, applicants are required to complete the APPLICATION IN ENGLISH, using the ONLINE APPLICATION

effort.quote: applicants are required to complete the APPLICATION IN ENGLISH, using the ONLINE APPLICATION and SUBMIT by the due date below:

eligibility.quote: Out of country travel to project site; Purchase of guns and ammunition; Paid informants; Tuition fees for Advanced Degrees; and Overhead, indirect, contingency, and miscellaneous costs.
PROJECT START DATE (Date to be NO SOONER than Feb. 1, 2027)(Required)
Applicants from India must demonstrate they or their organization have authorization to receive funds internationally and must attach FCRA documentation.

documents.quote: COUNTRY PROJECT LOCATION(Required) (Attach a Map of the Country where the Project is located.) Accepted file types: jpg, jpeg, pdf, doc, docx, png, Max. file size: 512 MB, Max. files: 2. **SPECIFIC PROJECT LOCATION(Required) (Attach a Map of the SPECIFIC Location where the project is located within the Country.)
Attach a recent photo of an elephant or elephants found in the area where project activities will occur.
Timeline Spreadsheet (document) / Budget Spreadsheet (document) / Copy of Organization/Entity Country Recognition - if appropriate (document) / Investigator and Co-Investigator(s) CV
PERMITS, LETTERS of SUPPORT and/or COOPERATION and GOVERNMENT ENDORSEMENT
An Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC) approval is required whenever research, testing, or teaching activities involve the use of live vertebrate animals.
Applicants from India must demonstrate they or their organization have authorization to receive funds internationally and must attach FCRA documentation.
